newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian man rises from the dead in morgue.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian man rises from the dead in morgue.

text.p: An Egyptian man who was erroneously pronounced dead and put in the morgue came back to life 12 hours later, an Egyptian newspaper said on Monday.
Egyptian doctors had examined Abdel Sattar Badawi and pronounced him dead. They issued him a death certificate and put him in the hospital's morgue, al-Akhbar newspaper said.
Badawi, an Imbaba resident who was in coma after suffering kidney failure, regained consciousness while in the morgue and started calling for help, it said.
He was discovered by two hospital employees who had come into the morgue to remove another body.
